method: Per-person first 70% chronological training; final 30% test; fixed ridge regression; same complete-wearable test dates for all models; no test tuning.

limitations: Participants are not an endometriosis cohort; fatigue is not pelvic pain or daily-life interference.
Retrospective export dates do not prove wearable measurements were available in real time.
Complete-wearable test dates can select a nonrepresentative subset; missing outcomes are not imputed.
No confidence intervals or external participant-held-out evaluation; small model differences are not established benefit.
No diagnosis, clinical validation, prospective symptom forecast, or proof of earlier diagnosis.
